title: Is Organic food better for you? Organic vs Non-Organic Foods
summary: Doctor's short video saying organic matters for produce eaten with the peel, not peeled foods, and that an organic label does not make a food healthy.

assertions.quote: you're probably not going to get a huge amount of benefit by paying the extra money for organic

verdicts.note: The lowest-residue Clean Fifteen is dominated by thick-peeled produce (pineapple, avocado, papaya, onion, watermelon, mango, banana, kiwi), tested after peeling as eaten.

assertions.quote: you're going to avoid those pesticides herbicides
just because it says organic on the label isn't guaranteeing that that food is good for you
